title: Execute A Scoped Plan Phase
description: Measure whether an agent can use Zenith context to implement only the current phase and preserve roadmap scope.
prompt: Implement the current Zenith plan phase. Keep changes scoped to the phase acceptance criteria, verify the work, and report what should be recorded in Zenith after verification.
setup: Create an active plan with at least two phases.
Mark the first phase in_progress and include concrete acceptance criteria.
Include one unrelated deferred roadmap item to test scope control.
successCriteria: Uses the current phase as the implementation target.
Does not work on deferred roadmap items.
Lists verification commands before marking work done.
Explains whether to use done, blocked, checkpoint, or lower-level plan advance.
privacyRules: Do not store full model transcripts.
Do not include secrets, credentials, tokens, or full diffs in benchmark records.
Record only scenario id, variant, timestamps, and evaluator-entered scores.

metrics.label: Scope control
metrics.description: Evaluator score from 1 to 5 for staying within phase scope.

metrics.label: Verification included
metrics.description: Whether the response includes relevant verification commands.
